Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a flowchart for this booking workflow. Connect exactly these six stages in order: Start booking, Choose date, Enter contact details, Review booking, Confirm booking, Booking complete. The first stage is start, the last stage is end, the other stages are process nodes.

response.text: Start booking is connected with Choose date which is then connected with Enter contact details which is further connected with Review bookinging which is finally connected with Confirm bookinging.
